name: TEST DISTRICT - DESK
intro: Welcome to the Test District. This is a separate saved world built from the same scenes, engine and editor as the game.
Go to the counter through the door. Use the Test Desk at the empty chair for prices, balance, branching dialogue and an atomic conversation purchase.

pages: A paper book, chained to its stand. The title has worn off the spine.
A bus ticket marks page 212. Yesterday it was page 211.

people.name: SHELF-E
talk: First circuit. Talk to me again: I cycle through two responses and remember my position.
Second circuit. My next response returns to the first.
